adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous code did `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` and, on failure, logged a detailed `console.error(... tokenResponse.error ... responseJson)`. The new code replaces this with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, and `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on schema failure without logging the zod error or the provider/sync response. So the finding is diff-grounded: validation diagnostics that previously existed were removed with no replacement, reducing observability for incompatibilities (especially when using the sync endpoint).
